verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents a RESTful API to much of its data, including a list-items endpoint with environment, level and status filters and pagination. Its OpenAPI 3.1 spec has Item and Occurrence resources, which covers listing and querying issues and suggests access to raw events. Access tokens are documented with scopes: a post_client_item token can only send events and cannot read data, and the community notes per-project read tokens. missing for 10: explicit documentation of updating items (status/owner) via the API, explicit documentation of fetching individual raw occurrences, a full list of token scopes, independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
